newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Leumi to start roadshow in May.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Leumi to start roadshow in May.

text.p: Israel's Bank Leumi is to start its roadshow presentations in early May and hopes to raise 600 million shekels from a 10 percent offering, a spokesman for the Israeli underwriters said on Wednesday.
Merrill Lynch and Lehman Brothers are the international distributors for the offering which will include shares and warrants and is expected to take place in the second half of May.
The international distribution will be to institutional investors, mainly in Europe.
The spokesman said the offering was expected to raise up to $1 billion up to the end of the year.
The Israeli underwriters are Leader Underwriters, I.B.I. Underwriting & Investment and Analyst Issue Management who will also serve as managers of the underwriting group.
The Israeli government is expecting to raise three billion shekels from the sale of Israeli bank shares this year.
